description: The figure is a donut-style pie chart representing the distribution of “Task Type” in the referenced study, and it contains two slices. One large slice labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” is shown in a muted red/pink color, and a smaller slice labeled “Headline generation (16.8%)” is shown in a pale yellow color. The chart places the title text “Task Type” in the center of the donut, and the category labels include percentages next to them outside the ring; there is no separate legend and no slices appear exploded or otherwise visually emphasized.
